newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-FANS UNHAPPY OVER MONDAY GAMES ASK FOR COMPENSATION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FANS UNHAPPY OVER MONDAY GAMES ASK FOR COMPENSATION.

text.p: Season-ticket holders at Spanish first division Valladolid have asked for compensation because a television contract means many of the club's games have been moved to Monday.
"We bought the season tickets before this contract was signed...and now we find that we can't use them," one fan said.
Monday night games, which begin at 9.30pm local time, were introduced this season after the Antenta 3 station reached agreement with a number of clubs.
Valladolid and Sporting Gijon, with no midweek European commitments, have had a disproportionate number of home games moved to Monday.
Several players have also expressed dissatisfaction over the change.
